# A prop reading records whose handler writes what the prop reads, run on every
# target a test can execute on: picking an entry writes the language, the
# summary drawn from the records follows, and an entry of the list the update
# rebuilt patches the summary in its turn. testdata/record_handler_prop.txtar
# is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

const languages = ["en", "fr", "de"]

component picker(items ...component ui.menuItem) ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #summary(value=items.map(func(it) => it.checked ? "[{it.label}]" : it.label).format(" "))
        for var it = items {
            ui.button #pick(text=it.label, @click {
                it.select()
            })
        }
    }
}

component app root {
    var language = "en"

    ui.window(title="Languages") {
        picker #p {
            for var l = languages {
                ui.menuItem(label=l, checked=l == language, @select {
                    language = l
                })
            }
        }
    }
}

app()

func testPickingAnEntryUpdatesTheSummary(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.p.summary.value == "[en] fr de")
    c.p.pick[1].click()
    t.assert(c.language == "fr")
    t.assert(c.p.summary.value == "en [fr] de")
}

func testAnEntryOfTheUpdatedListUpdatesItAgain(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.p.pick[1].click()
    c.p.pick[2].click()
    t.assert(c.language == "de")
    t.assert(c.p.summary.value == "en fr [de]")
}
